title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (6/20): A Visitor to Wangjia Village
note_en: 又…又… links two feelings or qualities that are true at the same time: 李大爷知道真相后，又惊讶又好笑 "he was both amazed and amused." Unlike 和, which joins nouns, 又…又… goes in front of adjectives or verbs, and each one gets its own 又. English just says "both A and B," but in Chinese leaving out the first 又 sounds wrong.
